## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceLaunchController — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceLaunchController.kt

## Trigger

The preparation screen opening, in PreparationViewModel.init, which calls
RaceLaunchController.openPreparation — observed

## Today

openPreparation checks recordingRepository.findInProgress() alone to decide
between PreparationState.Resuming and opening a fresh session. When a race
is found in progress it returns Resuming without ever calling
exerciseSessionManager.open(), so ExerciseSessionManager's in-memory
sessionOpen flag stays false even though the Health Services session this
application started earlier may still be alive at the OS level, lost only
to the app process's death. Later, StopRaceController.stop() calls
exerciseSessionManager.close(), which no-ops because sessionOpen is false,
so that session is never actually ended. When no race is found in progress
(the race ended, or was abandoned, before EndOfRaceViewModel.init or
StopRaceController.stop() ran), openPreparation calls
exerciseSessionManager.open() unconditionally, which calls
ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.startExerciseSession(). That method reads
ExerciseTrackedStatus and branches only on OTHER_APP_IN_PROGRESS
(ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.kt:46); ExerciseTrackedStatus.OWNED_EXERCISE_IN_PROGRESS
falls through to the same startExerciseAsync() call used for
NO_EXERCISE_IN_PROGRESS, attempting to start a second session on top of
the one this application already owns.

## Expected

At preparation opening, before deciding between resuming and starting
fresh, the application checks whether it already owns an exercise session
at the OS level. If it does and the database also has a race in progress,
the manager's in-memory state is reconciled with that owned session (so a
later close() will actually end it) and PreparationState.Resuming is
returned as today. If it owns a session but no race is in progress in the
database, that orphaned session is closed before a fresh one is opened. If
it owns no session, behaviour is unchanged.

This requires two things neither of which exists today:

1. ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.startExerciseSession() (or a new method on
   ExerciseSessionSystem) must distinguish
   ExerciseTrackedStatus.OWNED_EXERCISE_IN_PROGRESS from
   NO_EXERCISE_IN_PROGRESS — today it treats them identically and calls
   startExerciseAsync() in both cases, per ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.kt:44-61.
   ExerciseSessionStartOutcome (ExerciseSessionStartOutcome.kt) has no
   variant for "already owned by this app", distinct from
   ExerciseSessionStartOutcome.Started and DeviceSlotTaken; a new one is
   needed, and ExerciseSessionOpenResult (ExerciseSessionOpenResult.kt)
   needs a matching case so RaceLaunchController can act on it.

2. ExerciseSessionManager (ExerciseSessionManager.kt) has no operation to
   adopt an already-running session into its sessionOpen flag without
   attempting to start one, and no operation to close a session found
   owned but orphaned before opening a new one. Both are needed for
   RaceLaunchController.openPreparation to reconcile the database's
   in-progress race against the device's actual exercise session.

## Searched

ExerciseSessionManager, ExerciseTrackedStatus, OWNED_EXERCISE_IN_PROGRESS, OTHER_APP_IN_PROGRESS, startExerciseSession, openPreparation, findInProgress
